name: AVP Infracon Ltd.
summary: AVP Infracon Ltd. is an infrastructure development company engaged in a variety of civil construction projects across India. The company specializes in the construction of roads, including national highways and expressways, as well as bridges and flyovers. Its services extend to urban infrastructure development, commercial and residential buildings, and irrigation projects. AVP Infracon operates primarily through Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) and Bill of Quantities (BOQ) methods, offering end-to-end project management services encompassing design, estimation, and construction management. The company largely targets government and private infrastructure projects, with a significant presence in Tamil Nadu and plans for expansion into other Indian states. Key clients include government entities such as the National Highway Authority of India (NHAI), the Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (MoRTH), and various state public works departments.
